Chapter 1007: Chapter 19 Unprecedented Physical Body Divine Ability (Please Subscribe)

The thirteenth floor of the Sky Burning Court houses a vast collection of scriptures and inheritances, with the profundity increasing with each higher floor, progressing from simple to complex.

The first floor is the easiest to comprehend, while the thirteenth floor is the most abstruse and difficult.

Furthermore, to ascend to the next floor, one must completely comprehend all the scriptures and inheritances of the current floor.

This design was intentionally created by Lord Qingfen.

If there were no such restriction, Lin Yuan could access any floor at will,

and when encountering scriptures and inheritances he could not comprehend, he might dismiss them as being beyond his level.

Failing to understand would become a natural occurrence.

In Lord Qingfen’s conception, Lin Yuan would be trapped on the first floor, struggling to advance, only to realize he was still on the first floor.

With merely the content of the first floor being so abstruse, what would the second, third, and even thirteenth floors be like?

Such…. a natural sense of awe would undoubtedly arise.

At that point, Lord Qingfen would reappear, seize the opportunity to reprimand him strategically.

In merely a year or two, he could temper Lin Yuan’s mental resilience to the greatest extent.

“The thirteenth floor?”

Lord Qingfen looked over the Sky Burning Court, where Lin Yuan was currently seated on the thirteenth floor, fully immersed in browsing the vast collection of scriptures and inheritances of this level.

The corner of his mouth couldn’t help but twitch slightly.

Were it not for the myriad prohibitions within the Sky Burning Court being personally arranged by him, ensuring that no anomaly could escape his detection,

Lord Qingfen might even suspect that Lin Yuan had used some means to directly ascend from the first floor to the thirteenth floor.

“He comprehended the scriptures and inheritances of the twelve previous floors completely?” Lord Qingfen was incredulous, while the images in his mind began to flow backward.

Over the past year, the fragments of Lin Yuan’s progress from the first floor to the second, the second to the third… and finally from the twelfth to the thirteenth floor, flashed before him entirely.

“Three days to fully comprehend the scriptures of the first floor, sixteen days for the second, twenty-eight days for the third…”

The Sky Burning Court was created by Lord Qingfen himself, and everything within it could be easily ‘retraced’ by him, allowing no detail to escape.

“Based on the speed at which he comprehended the scriptures of the twelve previous floors, fully comprehending the scriptures and inheritances of the thirteenth floor should also be quick…”

The shock in Lord Qingfen’s heart was indescribable, and were it not for witnessing it with his own eyes, he could hardly believe such a being could exist in this world.

To condense the Seed of the Fierce Sun? That pertains to talent, something innate.

Lord Qingfen could still comprehend that.

But to fully grasp the countless scriptures and inheritances he had collected within just a year?

…

The thirteenth floor of the Sky Burning Court.

Lin Yuan swiftly browsed through one scripture and inheritance after another.

The scriptures and inheritances on the thirteenth floor were far more profound than those on the previous twelve floors, primarily delving into the principles of chaos birthing all things.

“Chaos Flame? Chaos Water? Chaos Gold? Chaos Space? Chaos Time?” Insights and inspiration continually sparked within Lin Yuan’s mind.

The countless scriptures and inheritances within the Sky Burning Court provided immense aid to him. Without these, the path Lin Yuan had walked to reach this point would likely have required far more unnecessary time.

“Ah, so that’s it.”

Lin Yuan put down the final scripture, his expression reflective.

“I could even try using the Chaos Rules as a foundation to evolve specific rules-based power?” Lin Yuan pondered silently to himself.

The standalone Golden Rules, even if completely comprehended, have attack limits that are ultimately capped, certainly inferior to the killing power of rules fused at the same level.

But Chaos Gold? That is power evolved from the Chaos Rules! Chaos Rules themselves aren’t inherently killing rules, but they can evolve and birth attack powers nearly without limit.

“Hmm?”

Lin Yuan raised his head and noticed a figure in a green robe standing not far away.

It was Lord Qingfen.

“Marquis.”

Lin Yuan immediately stood and greeted him.

Toward Lord Qingfen, Lin Yuan maintained a great deal of respect. On the cultivation path, the strong serve as mentors, and Lord Qingfen’s strength and realm were undoubtedly worthy of Lin Yuan’s admiration.

“Hmm.”

Lord Qingfen nodded and, after a moment, asked tentatively, “You’ve finished reading everything?”

“Yes.”

“Thank you, Marquis. These scriptures and inheritances have helped me greatly.”

Lin Yuan said sincerely.

“Helped you greatly…” Lord Qingfen was silent for a while. “If they’ve been of help to you… that’s good.”

Lord Qingfen glanced around and then continued, “Having completed reading all the scriptures and inheritances on the thirteenth floor, you must now have some understanding of your future cultivation path.”

Lin Yuan listened quietly.

“From today onwards, focus entirely on comprehending rules.”

Lord Qingfen said.

“What about condensing the Seed of the Fierce Sun?” Lin Yuan, filled with doubt, inquired.

“The Seed of the Fierce Sun?” Lord Qingfen shook his head. “The difficulty of condensing a single Seed of the Fierce Sun now is much greater than the previous thousands of Seeds of the Fierce Sun.”

“That’s true.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

“Condensing the Seed of the Fierce Sun serves two purposes.”

Lord Qingfen looked at Lin Yuan. “First, to enhance the breadth of rule comprehension; second, to transform the physical body into the Fierce Sun Divine Body.”

“Currently, your physical body has already begun its transformation. In at most ten thousand years, it’ll fully transform into the Fierce Sun Divine Body. The two purposes of the Seed of the Fierce Sun have essentially reached their extremes, and condensing more Seeds of the Fierce Sun won’t yield much benefit.”

Upon hearing this, Lin Yuan suddenly understood.

Lord Qingfen’s words were indeed true. For Lin Yuan, the benefits of condensing the Seed of the Fierce Sun now were far inferior to what they had been before.

This wasn’t because the enhancement of rule comprehension through the Seed of the Fierce Sun had diminished.

But rather because Lin Yuan’s foundational rule comprehension had already improved significantly.

In the beginning, Lin Yuan’s foundational rule comprehension was merely at ten; condensing one Seed of the Fierce Sun would increase it by one unit.

An instant increase of one-tenth could be immediately felt and visually perceived in its assistance to self-growth.
